title: Kristal-Catho — Authors, persons and works
scope_context: Person-first evidence discovery for Christian and Catholic intellectual history. Build author/person roster, then link works, claims, events, institutions and sources with explicit attribution. This is not an official canon.
notes: Use this as the first Kristal-Catho campaign; keep existing catho.json for doctrinal and institutional follow-up.
Every pass is a separate traversal and a separate QID job. Skope does not automatically union or deduplicate jobs across passes.
Person discovery is broad and incomplete: P106/P39 omissions and other religions require provenance-aware classification after full-record extraction.
Incoming P50 from a single author discovers works citing that author. There is no current batch join of all discovered people to all their authored works.
For historical/anonymous/collective works, distinguish author, attributed author, compiler, ecclesiastical issuer and institutional authority; verify original editions and source documents.
Wikidata claims are secondary discovery evidence, not validation of authorship or Catholic ecclesiastical authority.
No geographic filter: universal historical subject; Quebec/Canada can be separately prioritized during corpus enrichment.

passes.title: 01 · Theologians / potential authors · P106
passes.intent: Find people whose Wikidata occupation is theologian. Primary discovery population for intellectual authorship.
passes.risk: Includes non-Catholic theologians; many Catholic thinkers lack P106=theologian. Classify by period, tradition and provenance after extraction.

passes.title: 02 · Catholic priests · P106
passes.intent: Find Catholic priests; capture clerical authors and commentators who may not be registered as theologians.
passes.risk: An ordained priest is not automatically a writer; occupation values vary (Latin Catholic priest and others) so this is not a complete clergy census.

passes.title: 03 · Religious writers · P106
passes.intent: Find religious authors who are recorded primarily as writers rather than theologians.
passes.risk: Cross-religion population; do not infer Catholic affiliation from occupation. Do not use this pass as a canon filter.

passes.title: 04 · Catholic bishops · P106
passes.intent: Find bishops for episcopal letters, teaching, diocesan material and early authors.
passes.risk: Coverage differs where the person has a more specific Latin/rite occupation or only position held P39.

passes.title: 05 · Popes by office · P39
passes.intent: Find persons who held the papal office; review encyclicals, letters and pontifical texts with their issuing authority.
passes.risk: P39 completeness varies; official pontiff lists in Kristal must remain the authority roster. Pope office does not imply individual authorship of every signed text.

passes.title: 06 · Works attributed to Thomas Aquinas · P50
passes.intent: Prove person-to-work retrieval using an established author Q9438; collect items whose author P50 points to Thomas Aquinas.
passes.risk: Only works with structured P50 linking to Q9438 appear. Historical disputed attributions and manuscripts need separate evidence.

passes.title: 07 · Works attributed to Augustine · P50
passes.intent: Second author-to-work sample to validate ancient source coverage and record provenance.
passes.risk: Incomplete in Wikidata; multiple early works lack item pages or P50. Attribution and edition must be independently checked.
